reuse.why: Adds one getFixedGroupIds lookup reused by all actions, but parses the tag with its own regex instead of the existing shared/tags helpers (extractTagsFromText) and adds no shared category selection for the month-wide actions.

duplication.why: The same fetch-the-set-then-skip pattern is pasted into six month-wide actions and a seventh variant in goal-template, beside the already repeated hidden/template checks.

placement.why: The fixed-group lookup sits in budget/actions.ts and goal-template imports it from there, which fits, but tag recognition is defined locally rather than in shared/tags.ts where the tree keeps note-tag parsing.

scope.why: Focused on the rule plus a test and release note; widening getBudgetData/BudgetData with cat_group is incidental support.

maintainability.why: Which groups are fixed is defined once, but every month-wide action must remember to call and check it, so a new action or a further exclusion rule means editing seven sites again.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/budget/actions.ts FIXED_TAG regex re-implements note-tag matching that shared/tags.ts (extractTagsFromText) already provides, with different case sensitivity.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated `if (fixedGroupIds.has(cat.cat_group)) continue/return` checks are plain repetitions in copyPreviousMonth, setZero, set3MonthAvg, setLastMonthSpending, set12MonthAvg, set6MonthAvg, not disguised.

one_place.where: The fixed-group rule is defined once in getFixedGroupIds (server/budget/actions.ts) and every month-wide path (the six actions and goal-template computeTemplates) uses it, though each applies the skip itself.
